questions.text: 1. Bikrligi 10 N/m bo‘lgan prujinaga qanday massali (kg) yuk osilsa, tebranish davri 1 s bo‘lgan mayatnik hosil bo‘ladi? π2 = 10.
2. Prujinaga osilgan 200 g massali yuk bir minutda 30 marta tebranadi. Prujinaning bikrligi necha N/m? π2 = 10.
3. Bikrligi 200 N/m bo‘lgan prujinaga osilgan yuk 8 s da 10 marta tebrandi. Yukning massasi qanday (kg)? π2 = 10.
4. Prujinali mayatnik, og‘irlik kuchi tezlanishi Yernikidan 4 marta katta bo‘lgan planetaga Yerdan olib o‘tildi. Bunda uning tebranish davri qanday o‘zgaradi?
5. Agar tebranishlar davri T bo‘lgan prujinali mayatnikga osilgan yukning massasi n marta oshirilsa, tebranishlar davri qanday bo‘ladi?
6. Prujinali tebrangich (mayatnik) dagi yukning massasi 9 marta ortsa, bo‘ylama tebranishlar davri qanday o‘zgaradi?
7. Agar prujina 2 marta qisqartirilib, yukning massasi 2 marta orttirilsa, prujinali mayatnikning tebranish davri qanday o‘zgaradi?
8. 1-rasmdagi sistemaning tebranish davri 10 s, 2-rasmda esa 8 s. 3-rasmdagi yukning tebranish davrini toping (s). Barcha prujinalarning bikirligi bir xil.
9. Rasmda tasvirlangan prujinali mayatniklarning tebranish davrlari nisbati T1/T2 ni toping? 1) k, 3k (parallel); 2) 2k, 2k (ketma-ket), 4m massali.
10. Prujina o‘ziga osilgan yuk ta’sirida 2,5 cm ga cho‘zildi. Shu prujinali mayatnikning tebranish chastotasini aniqlang (Hz).
11. Quyidagi m massali yukning tebranish davrini aniqlang (prujinalar k, k, k ko'rinishida ulanishi).
